meta.analyst_notes: RLY-2608 is a mutant-selective PI3Kα inhibitor designed to avoid the hyperglycemia seen with non-selective agents (alpelisib, copanlisib). Selectivity for H1047R over wild-type creates a cleaner safety profile, enabling continuous dosing and CDK4/6 combination potential. Phase 1 showed ORR ~40% in H1047R-selected HR+/HER2- mBC patients treated with RLY-2608 + fulvestrant (ASCO 2024). Key variant perception: market underestimates (1) class validation via inavolisib approval de-risking regulatory path, (2) tolerability advantage enabling earlier-line use and broader combinations, and (3) potential ex-H1047R label expansion.

what_would_change_thesis: Phase 2 ORR data: confirmed ORR ≥50% in H1047R cohort → strong bull case (+30-50% NAV). ORR <30% → clinical failure.
Inavolisib achieves superior PFS in real-world use → raises Phase 3 bar; reduces peak penetration assumption.
FDA grants accelerated approval on Phase 2 ORR → removes Phase 3 risk from base case (huge positive).
Safety signal (Grade 3 hyperglycemia despite selectivity) → removes key differentiator vs. alpelisib.
Partnership/BD deal at Phase 2 readout → milestone + royalty structure could deliver near-term value.
Company raises equity below current NAV/share → dilutive; watch burn rate vs. runway.
ctDNA / NGS testing rates increase faster than expected → addressable patient pool expands beyond 17K.
